name: ▶ Current experiment
description: Live view of what Claude is testing right now. NOW: a natural glider reflector in History+Wave (F = 0.052, k = 0.066): four still solitons in a square (25 px bonds) turned 60°. A glider arriving 14 px off-centre is caught, slides along the cluster and leaves turned ~49°, and the square is unharmed. It reflects repeatedly if shots are ~30k steps apart; faster than that, the history trail of the last glider spoils the next one. Tint = history c.
